values.note: Includes three double sites. Rigs must fit on the parking spur; no parking off the road. The FS page gives spurs of 25-55 ft, the district status table a 30-ft maximum spur.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Long Draw: Sites 25, Max Spur 30') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/long-draw-campground ('25 sites including three double sites'; 'The parking length ranges from 25 to 55 feet'), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/long-draw-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Actual dates depend on conditions; Long Draw Road's gate is open 7/1-11/30.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Canyon Lakes RD Campground Status: Long Draw 'July 1 - Nov 15'; Road Status: Long Draw FS 156 OPEN 7/1 - 11/30, 'Actual Dates Depend on Conditions'), read 2026-10-28

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/long-draw-campground ('First come, first served campground') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('First-come, first-served'), read 2026-10-28

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/long-draw-campground ('Single Site: $25 per night | Double Site: $51 per night') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('$25/51'), read 2026-10-28

note: Arapaho-Roosevelt NF campground at ~10,030 ft in spruce-fir forest off Long Draw Road (FR 156), about 10 miles south of Colorado Highway 14, roughly a kilometre north-east of Long Draw Reservoir's dam. Reservoir and stream fishing nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page + ARP conditions tables: confirmed 25 sites, vault toilets, potable water, first-come only, $25 single. Added max 30 (district table; FS page says 25-55), season 07-01..11-15, double-site fee note. Note's 'beside Long Draw Reservoir' corrected (~1 km) and field facts trimmed.
flags: Website: the stored https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/241121 returns 404 (the recreation.gov API has no campground 241121). The campground is first-come only; drop the link and keep the FS page.
Missing phone: Canyon Lakes Ranger District 970-295-6600 (ARP offices page; open by appointment).
Max length conflict: ARP conditions table 'Max Spur 30'' vs FS campground page 'The parking length ranges from 25 to 55 feet'. Recorded 30. Both are above 23 ft, so no criteria issue.
Operator: concessionaire-run ('Long Draw Campground is managed by a concessionaire under a special use permit' on the FS campground map, media/72183). Ownership federal stands.
Road: Long Draw Road FS 156 OPEN 7/1-11/30 (Canyon Lakes road table, updated 10/14/2026), no notes; no FS RV or 4WD wording. Unpaved, about 10 miles from Highway 14.
Status: 'Site Open' on the FS page; season runs to Nov 15.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront) stands, and the note's 'beside Long Draw Reservoir' was wrong: on imagery the campground loop sits in forest ~1.1 km north-east of the reservoir's dam and full-pool shoreline, with no water view. A small creek runs ~200 m north of the loop.
Pin 40.5154,-105.76803 sits on FR 156 at the campground entrance, ~100 m west of the FS coordinate 40.51535,-105.76684 (inside the loop). No recreation.gov catalog to compare. OK.
